paper.title_en: Stochastic gravitational waves from narrow-band cosmological magnetic fields
paper.abstract_en: We calculate the spectrum of gravitational waves generated by a cosmological magnetic field with a narrow-band power spectrum. For a spectrum narrowly peaked at a comoving wavenumber $k_c$, we find that the gravitational wave signal peaks at $2k_c$ and has a sharp cutoff at this scale. We apply this result to an ultralight dark matter model of magnetogenesis operating around recombination, in which an axion-photon coupling generates a helical magnetic field by parametric resonance. We determine the conditions for the resulting gravitational waves to enter the frequency range of pulsar timing experiments. Although the required frequency can be reached for sufficiently large coupling, the corresponding amplitude is below the experimental sensitivity for physically allowed energy densities of the magnetic field. We generalize this conclusion to models of magnetogenesis operating at other epochs, estimating as $T \simeq 160 \mathrm{MeV}$ the temperature of a magnetogenesis process assumed to be the source of the stochastic gravitational wave background suggested by pulsar timing arrays. We place the lower bound $T \gtrsim 1$-$10 \mathrm{MeV}$ on such viable models.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究窄带宇宙磁场产生的随机引力波谱，并将其与脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）观测的频率范围与灵敏度相对照，还给出磁发生过程温度的下限约束，属于PTA方向的核心理论工作，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 窄带宇宙磁场产生的随机引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们计算了具有窄带功率谱的宇宙磁场所产生的引力波谱。对于在共动波数 $k_c$ 处窄峰化的谱，我们发现引力波信号在 $2k_c$ 处达到峰值，并在该尺度上具有尖锐的截断。我们将这一结果应用于一种在复合时期前后运行的超轻暗物质磁发生模型，其中轴子-光子耦合通过参量共振产生螺旋磁场。我们确定了由此产生的引力波进入脉冲星计时实验频率范围的条件。尽管在足够大的耦合下可以达到所需频率，但对于物理上允许的磁场能量密度，相应的振幅低于实验灵敏度。我们将这一结论推广到在其他时期运行的磁发生模型，估计一个假定的磁发生过程温度约为 $T \simeq 160 \mathrm{MeV}$，该过程被认为是脉冲星计时阵列所提示的随机引力波背景的来源。我们对这类可行模型给出下界 $T \gtrsim 1$-$10 \mathrm{MeV}$。
